tsm.chronos_bolt_tiny.what: Amazon's pretrained model (9 M parameters), zero-shot: it forecasts your series without training on it. 80 % interval from its quantiles, 95 % widened from it. Fast on the CPU.
tsm.chronos_bolt_small.what: Amazon's pretrained model (48 M parameters), zero-shot, a little more accurate than Tiny. 80 % interval from its quantiles, 95 % widened from it. Fine on the CPU.
tsm.chronos_bolt_base.what: Amazon's largest Chronos-Bolt (205 M parameters), zero-shot. Uses the graphics card when Settings › Compute allows it.
tsm.chronos_2.what: Amazon's pretrained model (120 M parameters), zero-shot, with drivers: known-in-advance variables enter as covariates. In Forecast every group, it learns across the series. Native 80 % and 95 % intervals.
tsm.timesfm_2p5.what: Google's pretrained model (200 M parameters), zero-shot, up to 256 periods ahead. 80 % interval from its quantiles, 95 % widened from it.
tsm.nhits.what: A small network trained here on this series' windows (CPU): each block reads a coarser view of the past and predicts a few points, interpolated. Intervals from its validation errors.
tsm.nbeats.what: A small stack of fully connected blocks trained here on this series' windows (CPU), each removing what it explains. Intervals from its validation errors.
fcai.state.needs_extra: Needs the AI forecasting extra (PyTorch, about 2 GB): {install}
fcai.state.offline: Never download is on: copy the model's folder into {folder}
fcai.state.browser: Not in the browser version: it needs PyTorch. Use the desktop app.
fcai.tooShort: Needs at least {min} periods (this series has {periods}), or 10 groups or more in Forecast every group: with fewer windows a network does worse than the statistical models.
fcai.download.title: Download {title}?
fcai.download.body: Downloads the {title} model ({size}, {licence}) from Hugging Face, once.
fcai.download.safety: Your data is not sent anywhere: forecasting runs on this computer.
fcai.download.progress: Downloading {title}: {pct} %. Run forecast waits until it is there.
fcai.suggest.short: Only {periods} periods: too short to train models (they need {threshold}). A pretrained model forecasts it without training.
fcai.suggest.long: {periods} periods: enough to train a network. N-HiTS learns this series' patterns on the CPU.
settings.modelsIntro: AI forecasting models. Pretrained ones are downloaded once, after your confirmation, into the folder below; your data is never sent anywhere.
settings.models.folderHint: Inside the app's folder, never the global Hugging Face cache: removing the app removes its models.
settings.models.neverHint: The app never contacts the network for a model. To use one, copy its folder here from a computer that downloaded it.
settings.models.neverForced: Set by DATA_EXPLORER_OFFLINE=1 where the app starts.
settings.models.trained: Trained on your series: nothing to download
settings.models.browser: AI forecasting models need the desktop app: the browser version has no PyTorch.
